abilities.name: Icon of Grimnir
abilities.effect: Add 1 to save rolls for friendly units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Plant the Icon
abilities.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, friendly units have **WARD (5+)** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Tough As Stone
abilities.effect:
Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for combat attacks that target this unit while every model in this unit is contesting an objective you control.

While this unit has any **grudge marks**, instead, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target this uni while this unit is wholly within enemy territory.

abilities.name: Duty Unto Death
abilities.effect: While your general is wholly within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and your general have **WARD (5+)**.

abilities.name: Browbeater
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly **Clanshields** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If this unit has any **grudge marks**, you can re-roll the roll. On a 3+, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s melee weapons until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Whirlwind of Destruction
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons if it charged in the same turn.

enhancements.name: Eager for Battle
enhancements.declare: Pick a friendly non-**MONSTER** unit to be the target.
enhancements.effect: The target can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

enhancements.name: Flaming Runes
enhancements.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Enemy Turn
enhancements.declare: Pick a friendly unit to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
enhancements.effect: Roll 6 dice. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. The unit using this ability cannot use this ability for the rest of the battle.

enhancements.name: Guided by Inghilde
enhancements.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
enhancements.declare: Pick a friendly **INFANTRY** unit to be the target.
enhancements.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 6" from all enemy units.

enhancements.name: Settle the Grudge
enhancements.declare: Pick an enemy unit to be **grudged**.
enhancements.effect: For the rest of the battle, you can re-roll hit rolls of 1 for combat attacks made by friendly **INFANTRY** units that target the **grudged** unit.

enhancements.name: Magmic Tunnels
enhancements.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Start of the First Battle Round
enhancements.effect: Pick up to 2 friendly units. Remove them from the battlefield and set them up again anywhere on the battlefield more than 6" from all enemy units.

enhancements.name: Fyresteel Throwing Axes
enhancements.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
enhancements.declare: Pick any number of friendly units that are not in combat and are within 10" of any enemy units.
enhancements.effect: For each of those units, pick a visible enemy unit within 10" of it and roll a dice. On a 4+, inflict D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit.

enhancements.name: Brazen Intimidation
enhancements.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
enhancements.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of your general to be the target.
enhancements.effect: Subtract D6 from the target’s control score until the start of your next turn.

enhancements.name: Well-honed Tactics
enhancements.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
enhancements.declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of your general to be the target.
enhancements.effect: The target can use **RETREAT** abilities and still use **CHARGE** abilities later in the turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on the target by **RETREAT** abilities it uses this turn.

enhancements.name: Ragnisson's Cobalt Ale
enhancements.effect: Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of your general’s melee weapon.

enhancements.name: Grudge-Led Retribution
enhancements.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat and had any damage points allocated to it this phase to be the target.
enhancements.effect: The target can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

enhancements.name: Powerful Presence
enhancements.effect: Add 3 to your general’s control score.

enhancements.name: Horn of Grimnir
enhancements.declare: Pick your general to use this ability if they are not in combat.
enhancements.effect: Roll a dice for each friendly unit on the battlefield that has any slain models. On a 3+, you can return 1 slain model to that unit.

enhancements.name: Spirit of Grimnir
enhancements.effect: You can re-roll **activation rolls** you make for the ‘Ur-gold Runes’ ability (see Battle Traits).

enhancements.name: Halo of Flames
enhancements.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
enhancements.effect: Your general has **WARD (4+)** for the rest of the turn. Then, from the start of the next turn, subtract 1 from ward rolls for your general for the rest of the battle.

enhancements.name: Stoke the Fire
enhancements.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Shooting Phase
enhancements.effect:
For the rest of the phase:
• The Attacks characteristic of your general’s **Roaring Fyrestream** is D3+4 instead of 4.
• For each unmodified hit roll of 1 for your general’s shooting attacks, allocate D3 damage points to your general after the **SHOOT** ability has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

enhancements.name: Fyrespawn
enhancements.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with your general to be the target.
enhancements.effect: Inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

enhancements.name: Lodgefather
enhancements.effect: Add 1 to ward rolls for friendly non‑**MONSTER** units while they are wholly within 3" of your general.

battleTraits.name: Fury for the Fallen
battleTraits.effect:
Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by your **Vulkyn Flameseekers** and **Auric Hearthguard** units while they have half or less than half of their starting models.

Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of your **Auric Runesmiter**’s melee weapons while it has 3 or more damage points.

Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of your general’s melee weapons while they have 8 or more damage points.

battleTraits.name: Fiery Reinforcements
battleTraits.effect: Set up this unit on the battlefield, within 1" of a battlefield edge and more than 6" from all enemy units.

battleTraits.name: Berserk Charge
battleTraits.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Reaction: You declared a Charge ability for a friendly unit
battleTraits.effect: You can re-roll the charge roll. If you do, until the start of your next turn, the unit using that **CHARGE** ability has **STRIKE‑FIRST** if it charged in the same turn.

battleTraits.name: Awaken the Runes
battleTraits.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Your Turn
battleTraits.declare: Pick 1 of the ur-gold runes from the **ur-gold runes** table, then make an **activation roll** of D6. Each urgold rune can only be activated once per battle.
battleTraits.effect: On a 1-5, the rune’s **standard effect** applies. On a 6, the rune’s **enhanced effect** applies as well. The effects last until the start of your next turn.

battleTraits.name: Honour Those With Gazul
battleTraits.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.effect: Give 1 **grudge mark** to a friendly unit.
